dependency.structure: All nodes, all labels, all relationship occurrences, directions and properties consumed by queries/guards.
dependency.property_rule: Retain whitelisted properties globally; content/contentWithEquations apply to Resolution-family nodes. Relationship properties use the same whitelist.
dependency.guard_dependencies: Anchor values use query properties; schema warnings use original token inventories; Spec roles use every adjacent relationship and specRelease; remaining guards use query text and returned values.
dependency.source_text: Resolution report passages are source-derived text; source rights and provenance apply.

historical_graph_identity: unrecorded; this is a separately captured current graph view

consistency.isolation: Sequential read transactions with complete repeated content fingerprints and before/after counts; concurrent writes invalidate reuse when detected.
